Team,

I'm starting to collect manager notes for our Q2 biannual check-ins. There are three things I want us to coordinate on this week:

1) Consolidated manager notes for each direct report using the template I've attached. Please be explicit about goals progress, stretch areas, and any potential performance concerns.
2) Any case you believe requires HR presence (pre-1:1 briefing or follow-up) — flag the person's name and a 2-3 line rationale. This is confidential; do not include PII in the notes.
3) A proposed timeline for delivering notes and having calibration before the next leads sync.

Marcus/Monica — can you send your drafts by EOD Thursday? I will loop People Ops if we need formal handling. Sensitive case to flag: one IC on my team (Alex) had repeated missed deadlines; I want to discuss whether we schedule HR to join before the one-on-one.

Hi Evelyn,

Thanks for looping People Ops. A few quick items from our side:

- If the expectation is an HR presence, we prefer a short pre-1:1 briefing (15–20m) with the manager and HR partner to align on facts and desired outcomes. That helps avoid surprises in the meeting and ensures we have documentation.
- For sensitive notes, please use the redaction guidance in the attached comp_guidelines. Avoid PII, medical info, and speculative language.
- If a performance plan or formal corrective action is likely, we will follow the standard workflow (HR intake -> manager notes -> draft PIP -> legal review if needed). That typically takes 2–3 business days for an initial plan.

We can join the briefing for Alex. Please share Marcus's short rationale and any examples you have, and we'll set up the pre-1:1 slot for Thu 3:00–3:30pm PT if that works.

Attachments: compensation_guidelines.pdf (application/pdf)

Best,
Samantha Pierce
